observations.posthog_connection: Changes the country display value when session properties are empty, potentially changing the displayed country from the person's stored value to an empty string or the person's value depending on the fallback logic. This could prevent a blank country display or incorrect country display if session properties are not loaded yet.

observations.behavior: Changes property merging order: person properties are spread first, then recording properties. This makes recording properties override person properties, whereas the previous code would have person properties override recording properties.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the precedence of country and other property values. If a recording has a country and a person has a different country, the recording's country will now win. This could change the displayed country for a session recording compared to the person's stored country.
